episodes.name: Making the Grade
episodes.overview: With the kids at school, Carol decides to take some college courses--the same ones Karen is taking. Meanwhile, Dana tells Rich to get serious about his education.

episodes.name: A Star is Born
episodes.overview: Al lands a part in a movie and dreams of a career in Hollywood; Carol gets in a bake-sale battle.

episodes.name: Your Cheatin' Heart
episodes.overview: Rich secretly takes dancing lessons to impress Dana at a wedding, but she thinks he's cheating on her.

episodes.name: Take This Job and ...
episodes.overview: JT's job at a garage is an accident waiting to happen; Frank is obsessed with restoring a boat docked in the backyard.

episodes.name: Poetic Justice
episodes.overview: The teaching assistant who's been giving A's to Karen now wants something in return; Mark dates a slacker girl.

episodes.name: Can't Buy Me Love
episodes.overview: Carol tries to convince an old classmate, now a rich developer, to hire Frank; Karen wants Dana to join a sorority.

episodes.name: Dream Lover
episodes.overview: Two Halloween parties result in a lesson about being scared for Lilly and a ghostly encounter for JT.

episodes.name: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
episodes.overview: Dana feels compelled to compete with an old female buddy of Rich's; Frank's troublesome cousin Bert reappears.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Mr. Chip
episodes.overview: Rich and JT feud; meanwhile, Karen takes advantage of boyfriend Chip's easy nature.

episodes.name: Too Many Santas
episodes.overview: Lilly has a crisis of faith when she discovers that the department store Santa is really JT.

episodes.name: Phoney Business
episodes.overview: Al gets a job modeling on a TV commercial, only to discover it was re-dubbed as a phone-sex ad.

episodes.name: Goin' to the Chapel
episodes.overview: JT falls for an aerobics instructor; Carol has a fight with Dana, who decides to get even by eloping with Rich.

episodes.name: Feet of Clay
episodes.overview: Dana talks Rich into taking a pottery class; Carol and Frank's "role playing" is misinterpreted by the kids.

episodes.name: Pain in the Class
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol attend their 25th high-school reunion, along with Frank's old rival; Rich and JT charge pals to watch a bikini contest on TV.

episodes.name: The Half Monty
episodes.overview: JT and Rich enter a male-stripper contest for quick cash to take their girlfriends on a promised ski trip.

episodes.name: And Justice for Some
episodes.overview: A truck giveaway causes friction between Frank and JT; a women's safety seminar is a big hit thanks to a hunky cop.

episodes.name: The Understudy
episodes.overview: Al, angry about being an understudy at a local play, refuses to learn her lines--something she regrets when the leading lady gets sick opening night.

episodes.name: We're in the Money
episodes.overview: Cody returns and gives Frank and Carol $50,000, which causes nothing but trouble as they decide how to spend it.

episodes.name: Movin' On Up
episodes.overview: Everybody is excited about the prospect of moving into a brand-new house--except Lilly.
